About

Why we exist

The UnknownNow started with a simple frustration: good neuroscience research rarely reaches the people it's actually about. We built an organization to close that gap.

Our mission

Science communication first, neuroscience as our lens

[Placeholder — replace with the org's own words.] We believe credible science shouldn't require a research background to understand. The UnknownNow exists to translate neuroscience and psychology research — the kind that usually stays locked in journals — into writing that's accurate, specific, and genuinely readable. Everything we do, from our published literature reviews to our internship program, is an expression of that one goal.

We take a foundation-first approach: we'd rather do a small number of things well and honestly than overstate what we've built. If something's still in progress, we say so.
